mapper.sql: id,dates,source_id, project_name,user_id,amount, fee,exchange_rate,change_amount, change_fee,status,version, pkg,country,register_date, register_dates,register_version,register_day, register_cohort_day,create_time
mapper.select: SELECT dupr.id, wr.dates, wr.id AS source_id, wr.project_name, wr.user_id, wr.status, wr.pkg, IFNULL(wr.amount, 0) AS amount, IFNULL(wr.fee, 0) AS fee, #{singleFee} AS exchange_rate, ROUND(IFNULL(wr.amount, 0) / #{singleFee}, 8) AS change_amount, ROUND(IFNULL(wr.fee, 0) / #{singleFee}, 8) AS change_fee, (SELECT MAX(uv.pvn) FROM ods_user_version uv WHERE uv.user_id = u.id AND uv.dates <= #{dates}) AS version, (SELECT MIN(uv.pvn) FROM ods_user_version uv WHERE uv.user_id = u.id AND uv.dates <= #{dates}) AS register_version, 'IN' AS country, u.dates AS register_dates, u.create_time AS register_date, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, u.create_time, wr.created) AS register_cohort_day, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, u.dates, wr.dates) AS register_day, wr.created AS create_time, DATE_FORMAT(wr.updated, '%Y%m%d') AS update_dates, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, u.create_time, wr.updated) AS register_withdraw_cohort_day, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, u.dates, wr.updated) AS register_withdraw_day, wr.updated AS update_time FROM (SELECT * FROM ods_payment_record_withdraw WHERE dates = #{dates} and id >= #{startId} and id <= #{endId}) wr INNER JOIN ods_user u ON wr.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN dwd_user_payment_record dupr ON dupr.source_id = wr.id
